title: 6061-T651 Plate: How to Buy It, and Where It Belongs in Aerospace and Defense
summary: A buying guide to 6061-T651 plate: material specifications, dimensions, applications, and the origin and certification requirements on your order.
body_markdown:
### What is 6061-T651 plate used for in aerospace?


Structural brackets and mounts, machined avionics and optics housings, UAS airframe structure, ground support equipment, and tooling and inspection fixtures. It is chosen where weldability, corrosion resistance and machinability matter more than peak strength.


### What specification covers 6061-T651 plate?


ASTM B209 for commercial work and AMS 4027 for aerospace, which covers 6061-T6 sheet and 6061-T651 plate. Older drawings reference AMS-QQ-A-250/11. Minimums are 42,000 psi ultimate and 35,000 psi yield.


### Is 6061-T651 good for defense parts?


6061 is used for many housings, mounts and support components when the design requirements permit it. It is not an armor specification. Follow the drawing and identify the origin and documentation requirements for the particular order rather than applying one rule to all defense work.


### Why is 6061-T651 better than T6 for machined parts?


T651 has been stress relieved by stretching after quenching. Machining unrelieved material unbalances trapped residual stress and the part moves, which shows up as bow or twist on large or thin-walled parts. T651 removes that stress at the mill.


### How thick does 6061-T651 plate come?


We stock 0.25 to 10 inches and cut to any rectangle on bandsaws with a 0.08 inch kerf. One square foot weighs 14.04 lbs per inch of thickness, so check the weight before ordering thick sections since it decides whether the order ships parcel or freight.
